bio: A truly magnificent setting! The restaurant of the Art Deco Imperial Hotel, a time-honoured establishment, occupies a stylish high-ceilinged room in which gorgeous historical ceramic detailing on the ceiling, walls and striking columns draws the eye. The atmosphere is lively without being hectic, and the service is well organised and professional. Featured on the classic-leaning menu is a good selection of dishes, including Czech favourites. As the place is worth seeing and attracts many guests, it's wise to book! Also open for breakfast, brunch, coffee and cake....
